scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,admin,client -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w admin-app" "npm run dev -w client-app"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/form-schema && tsc -p packages/form-renderer && tsc -p api && tsc -p admin-app && tsc -p client-app
scripts.build: npm run build -w admin-app && npm run build -w client-app
